item.title: Middle East war live: Trump says Iran war could end in 'two weeks, maybe three'
item.summary: US President Donald Trump said Tuesday that the war with Iran may be over in two or three weeks and it will be up to other countries to secure the vital Strait of Hormuz oil shipping channel. Follow our liveblog for the latest.

item.title: EU says Israel's plans to introduce death penalty law for Palestinians 'very concerning'
item.summary: The EU said on Tuesday that Israel's plans to legalise the death penalty for Palestinians found guilty of killing Israelis are "very concerning" and "a clear step backwards".
